description: Real authentication + session: rewrite AccountContext over Firebase Auth (observeAuth subscription, profile load, loading flag, signUp/signIn/signOut, partner-blocked-at-signup guard, and favorites state moved to per-id optimistic but still backed by the context Set), add the splash/loading gate and sole-owner redirect logic in _layout.tsx (RootNavigator), extend SignupScreen to collect email+password (removing the stray '3'), add the new /login route with a pure AuthLoginScreen, and wire index.tsx's onLogin. Depends on FEAT-001 (auth.ts/users.ts/auth-errors.ts/config.ts must exist). This feature establishes the auth/context surface that FEAT-003..006 consume (account.uid, loading).
steps: Rewrite src/state/account-context.tsx per design.md 'AccountContext refactor': Account = { name, role, uid } | null; context value = { account, loading, signUp, signIn, signOut, favorites, toggleFavorite, isFavorite }. Remove setAccount. On mount subscribe via auth.observeAuth(async user => {...}) with the exact handler shape from design.md: profile load in its own try/catch (failure or missing profile -> account=null + a one-time profileError string), favorites load in its own try/catch (failure -> empty Set), and setLoading(false) exactly once in a finally on every path. loading starts true. The context imports auth.ts/users.ts/favorites.ts/auth-errors.ts and NEVER firebase/auth directly.

In account-context: implement signUp({ name, role, email, password }) that FIRST normalizes role via users.normalizeRole; if the normalized role === 'partner', throw a plain Error with (err as any).code = 'app/partner-not-available' BEFORE any Firebase call (no auth user, no profile created for partner); otherwise await auth.signUp({ name, role, email, password }). signIn delegates to auth.signIn; signOut delegates to auth.logout. All three rethrow so wrappers can show messages. Keep a profileError internal one-time flag set in the handler.

In account-context: implement toggleFavorite(id) as the optimistic per-id version from design.md (guard no-op when account is null; use a favoritesRef useRef mirror to read pre-flip membership; optimistic flip; call favorites.add/removeFavorite(account.uid, id); on rejection revert ONLY that id). isFavorite(id) stays a pure favorites.has(id) lookup — identical signature so DiscoverScreen/BusinessScreen need no change.

Rewrite src/app/_layout.tsx per design.md's full authoritative snippet: keep SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync() at module load; RootLayout loads fonts and renders <AccountProvider><RootNavigator fontsReady={!!(fontsLoaded||fontError)} /></AccountProvider>; RootNavigator uses useAccount().{account,loading}, useSegments, useRouter; hideAsync() in a useEffect gated on fontsReady && !loading; a second useEffect is the SOLE owner of auth-state navigation using AUTH_ROUTES=['index','login','signup'] and segments[0] ?? 'index' (keep the fallback). Register the full Stack: index, login, signup, explore, discover, business, care, documents (login + documents are NEW route names).

Extend src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx keeping it pure: new props { role, onBack, onContinue: (input:{name,email,password})=>void, asset?, topInset?, submitting?, errorMessage? }. Add email + password controlled inputs with refs (name returnKeyType 'next' focuses email; email keyboardType 'email-address' + autoCapitalize 'none' + autoCorrect false + 'next' focuses password; password secureTextEntry + autoCapitalize 'none' + 'done' triggers handleContinue). canContinue requires name.trim().length>1 && email matches /\S+@\S+\.\S+/ && password.length>=6 && !submitting. handleContinue calls onContinue({ name: name.trim(), email: email.trim(), password }). While submitting show an ActivityIndicator instead of the arrow and keep the button disabled; render errorMessage as a terracotta line above the button. REMOVE the stray trailing '3' on the canContinue line. Leave the isNavy/ROLE_CONTEXT tone branch and constants.ts untouched.

Rewrite src/app/signup.tsx per design.md: keep role from useLocalSearchParams with current normalization; replace setAccount usage with useAccount().signUp; hold local submitting/errorMessage; onContinue is async -> setSubmitting(true), setErrorMessage(undefined), try await signUp({name,role,email,password}) (NO router.replace), catch setErrorMessage(toPtMessage(e)), finally setSubmitting(false). Remove the partner early-return TODO. Pass submitting + errorMessage down to SignupScreen.

Create src/screens/AuthLoginScreen.tsx (pure, no Firebase/picker import) in the existing visual language (offwhite bg, navy primary button, hairline inputs, Hanken fonts, same button pattern as SignupScreen). Props: { topInset?, onSubmit:({email,password})=>void|Promise<void>, onBack, submitting?, errorMessage? }. Email input keyboardType 'email-address' + autoCapitalize 'none' + autoCorrect false; password secureTextEntry. Submit enabled only when email.trim().length>0 && password.length>0 && !submitting (deliberately NO regex / NO length>=6 — server validates). While submitting show ActivityIndicator + disabled. Render errorMessage.

Create src/app/login.tsx (new route wrapper): holds router + useSafeAreaInsets, local submitting/errorMessage; renders AuthLoginScreen with topInset, onBack=()=>router.back(), and async onSubmit=({email,password})=> try await useAccount().signIn({email,password}) (NO navigation on success — RootNavigator redirects), catch setErrorMessage(toPtMessage(e)), finally clear submitting.
Edit src/app/index.tsx: uncomment/wire onLogin={() => router.push('/login')} on the LoginScreen (FR-A3, AC-4). Leave the role-picker LoginScreen screen itself unchanged.

Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` and fix all errors (watch for every call site of the old setAccount and the old SignupScreen onContinue(name) signature — business.tsx/care.tsx/explore.tsx read account but do not call setAccount; confirm nothing else references removed surfaces).
acceptance_criteria: useAccount().account exposes { name, role, uid } when signed in and null when signed out; useAccount().loading is true while auth/profile resolves and false after (AC-8/9).
The context exposes signUp, signIn, signOut, toggleFavorite(id), isFavorite(id) with toggleFavorite/isFavorite keeping their current signatures (AC-10).

Signing up with name+email+password creates an auth user and a users/{uid} profile for elder/family and routes to /explore via RootNavigator only; a partner signup throws app/partner-not-available before any Firebase call (no auth user, no profile) and stays on signup with the 'em breve' message (AC-2/3, design partner decision).
A new /login route renders AuthLoginScreen and lets an existing user sign in with email+password; 'Ja tenho conta - Entrar' on the role picker navigates there (AC-4).

_layout.tsx holds the native splash until fontsReady && !loading, registers all eight routes (incl. login + documents) so typed routes compile, and is the sole owner of auth-state redirects (AC-1/5); SignupScreen no longer contains the stray '3'.
`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` both pass with no errors (AC-30).
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` from the worktree root and confirm zero errors (this catches the removed setAccount and the new onContinue object signature propagating through signup.tsx).
Run `npx expo lint` from the worktree root and confirm zero errors.
Confirm (read _layout.tsx) all eight Stack.Screen entries exist and SignupScreen.tsx has no stray '3' token.
findings: AccountContext public surface for FEAT-003..006: useAccount() returns { account: { name, role, uid } | null, loading, signUp, signIn, signOut, favorites: Set<string>, toggleFavorite(id), isFavorite(id) }. setAccount is GONE — any future wrapper must use signUp/signIn/signOut, never setAccount. account.uid is the Firestore users/{uid} key for all per-user subcollection reads (favorites/tasks/documents). loading is true until the first observeAuth resolution (+profile/favorites load) completes, then false; _layout RootNavigator gates the splash and owns ALL auth-state redirects, so FEAT-003..006 wrappers must NOT call router.replace to a protected route. profileError is an internal one-time flag in the context (set when an auth user has no users/{uid} profile); it is intentionally NOT part of the public context value, so it is not consumable by screens yet — if a later feature needs to surface it, promote it in the context value explicitly. toggleFavorite is a no-op when account is null and reverts only the single id on failure; isFavorite stays a pure Set.has lookup (DiscoverScreen/BusinessScreen unchanged). NEW routes registered in _layout Stack: 'login' (implemented here, src/app/login.tsx + src/screens/AuthLoginScreen.tsx) and 'documents' (route file NOT yet created — FEAT that implements documents must add src/app/documents.tsx; the Stack.Screen entry already exists, and no router.push('/documents') is made yet so typed routes still compile). SignupScreen onContinue is now ({ name, email, password }) => void (object, not a bare string); AuthLoginScreen onSubmit is ({ email, password }) => void | Promise<void>. Partner is blocked in AccountContext.signUp BEFORE any Firebase call (throws Error with code 'app/partner-not-available', mapped to the 'em breve' PT message by auth-errors.toPtMessage). Login client validation is intentionally weak (both fields non-empty only, no regex/length>=6) — server validates. Verification: npx tsc --noEmit = 0 errors; npx expo lint = 0 errors (1 pre-existing warning in DiscoverScreen, outside FEAT-002 scope). NOTE: tsc/lint passing does NOT prove runtime correctness — real signup/login against Firebase still needs a manual Expo Go smoke test, and config.ts credentials/storageBucket must be filled per design before first run.
